title: Fable has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue 🗣️
subject: fable
description:
Are you playing Fable at launch? 👇

Playground Games co-founder Ralph Fulton told GamesIndustry.biz that over 100 voice actors from across the UK recorded more than 150,000 lines of dialogue for Fable. At Summer Game Fest 2026 he said multiple studios had been recording voice-over in parallel for over 1,000 hours that year. GamesRadar puts Skyrim at around 60,000 spoken lines. Fable launches February 23, 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PS5 and PC.

Sources: GamesRadar+ (Nov 26, 2026), GamesIndustry.biz, TechRadar (June 11, 2026), VGC (June 2026)

scenes.text: Fable has more than 150,000 lines of dialogue.
Ralph Fulton, co-founder of Playground Games, told GamesIndustry.biz that over 100 voice actors recorded them.
They come from every corner of the UK, with voices from places like Sheffield, Belfast and Edinburgh.
Back in June, Fulton said several studios had been recording in parallel for over 1,000 hours this year alone.
For scale, GamesRadar puts Skyrim at around 60,000 spoken lines.
Fable launches February 23, 2027 on Xbox Series X|S, PS5 and PC.
